response.rationale: The item is electronics delivered 9 days ago. The highest-priority applicable rule is RET-002 (electronics returnable within 15 days), which is satisfied since days_since_delivery (9) <= 15. Final-sale (RET-012), defective (RET-020), goodwill (RET-050), and fraud-hold (RET-051) rules do not apply as their conditions are false. Thus the return is eligible.
